{{Quote|A deadly Zabrak named Kilth Saanu leads the Banshees. If you take her out, chances are the rest of the Banshees will scatter. If not, then just blast all of them.|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
'''Kilth Saanu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] criminal who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the leader of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] of [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]] known as the [[Desert Banshees]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Saanu and the Desert Banshees proposed to join [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]]. The swoopers were thus assigned to various missions so Jabba could evaluate whether they were worthy of joining his organization. This situation was later discovered by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate]] and main rival of Jabba.<ref name="SWG:LV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Lady Valarian therefore tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with eliminating the Desert Banshees. The spacer eventually found Kilth Saanu and four of his thugs near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and killed them all in the ensuring firefight.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateBodyguardZabrakFemale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depiction of Kilth Saanu]]
Kilth Saanu was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kilth Saanu was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

Because Kilth Saanu spawned under the generic "bodyguard_zabrak_female" template, her appearance was randomized under one of four possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset. Nevertheless, she systematically appeared as a Zabrak female.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Kilth Saanu was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
